artist.name: VANI
artist.based_city: California, USA (state only; she grew up in Los Angeles)
artist.bio: VANI (Vani Dewan) is an open-format DJ based in California who grew up in Los Angeles and blends afrobeats, baile funk, desi fusion, bass house and hardgroove. She is also a doctoral researcher at USC's Brain and Creativity Institute, and has supported Jyoty, Zeemuffin, Flowdan, Mastane, KSHMR and DJ ADHD in the US and Asia, including an India tour.

eras.sound: Open-format sets of afrobeats, baile funk and desi fusion

press.title: Vani Dewan is the neuroscientist-DJ explaining why your brain loves the dancefloor
